```
GATEWAY 503s — HANDOFF

Root cause: dep-4471 set gateway.pool.perRequest false -> true.
Each request now takes its own connection. Pool size 20 never grows.
Every 503 carries ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED. Wait queue climbed 13 -> 271.
Churn hit 4180 opens per 5m, baseline 40.

Impact: 02:14:18Z to 03:59:27Z, still active at log end. 530 x 503.
All 5 routes, all 4 upstreams. Error rate 71% at the 03:21 page.

Roll back: dep-4471 (gateway, a.novak). Nothing else.
dep-4472 and dep-4473 shipped after 503s began.

Not related: worker job time rose 278ms -> 2092ms, starting 01:00.
Predates the deploy. db_wait flat at 5ms. Needs its own ticket.
```

One caveat. This log is node-3 of 3. I have not seen nodes 1 and 2.
